description: This PHP source file defines the AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI class, which extends another API class to check for overlap in punch-out records within an attendance management system. It includes an API endpoint definition with parameters such as employee number, timezone offset, date, and time, and implements the logic to verify punch-out overlaps via attendance service methods.

classes.name: AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoint to check for punch-out record overlaps, inheriting from AttendancePunchInRecordOverlapAPI and implementing a GET method to verify overlap status.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to check and return whether a punch-out record overlaps with existing records, utilizing request parameters, date/time conversions, and attendance service checks.
